name: repo_map
description: Generate a structured code map of the project. Full output is ~36K tokens (~456 files with top-level symbols). For token-efficient queries, use focused=true + relevantEntities to get a targeted ~50 token map of only the files containing specific symbols.

dir.description: Root directory to map (default: workspace root, a subdir of 0通天/)

focused.description: If true, limit output to ~2000 tokens by pruning symbols. Combine with relevantEntities for best results.

relevantFiles.description: Only include these specific files (paths relative to workspace root, e.g. ["scripts/lib/tools/spawn.mjs"])

relevantEntities.description: Only include files that contain these top-level symbols (e.g. ["spawnFixer", "agentLoop"])
